canvas.coordinateSemantics: Screen-space placements for this fixed 3/2 room composition; sprite canvases share a bottom-centred floor pivot.

camera.description: Lett opphøgd hjørneperspektiv frå romopninga. Veggkantane er loddrette; alle golvmøblar brukar same visingshøgd, golvakse og skala.

spriteRules: Each selectable variant uses the same logical canvas size and the same bottom-centred ground pivot within its family.
Furniture is drawn from one low three-quarter camera height; vertical edges stay vertical and room floor axes stay consistent.
The bed headboard belongs at the back-right and its footboard points front-left; never mirror a bed variant.
Desk fronts face the room; chair seats face the desk; sofa fronts face the TV; TV screens face the sofa.
Rugs lie flat with their long sides aligned to the room floor axes.
Use soft neutral diffuse daylight through the window, with no sunset tint, sunbeams, strong ambient glow or hard cast shadows.
A larger furniture variant may grow inside its declared footprint, but its family pivot remains fixed; recheck clearance and accessory mounts after resizing.
